name: search-morph
title: Search Morph
description: A search button that stretches into a search field, with Cancel sliding in and results rising beneath.

perf.budget: One shared value drives the stretch, the field and Cancel. The shell's edges animate, so it lays out for the length of the spring; nothing runs at rest.

measurements.notes: Measured with its own script (open, type, close) since the default gestures miss it; slower frames come from the keyboard opening and closing.

a11y.reducedMotion: The field opens and closes in place.
a11y.screenReader: A Search button that becomes a text field named by the placeholder, with Clear search and Cancel buttons. Hidden parts are hidden from screen readers.
a11y.touchTarget: The button, the clear button and the bar are all 48 pt tall.
